QUOTE: The four thread-spawn sites the index finds are all in `programs/` (`ssl_pthread_server.c:277`, `benchmark.c:430/444`, `ssl_server2.c:1699`). The library spawns nothing.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the library spawns no threads. It never says that library/ supplies the mutex abstraction (threading.h/threading.c) that threaded callers use. It describes the mutexes as internal protection for the library's own state.
